annotations.title: Create or modify a Souk entry

description: Create or modify an entry of the user's own Parfumo Souk for a perfume: an offer or a search request, for a bottle or a sample (`kind`), with trade wanted, condition, size, price, shipping and a note. With `souk_id` an existing entry is modified, otherwise one is created. PUBLIC: the entry shows in the Souk and on the member's profile; only private trade is allowed and transactions are at the user's own risk. Parfumo does not let recent accounts create offers: the tool then reports it and sends nothing. Removing an entry is not handled (do it on parfumo.com). Free-text fields must be the user's own words. On this server such writes stay in dry-run mode unless the operator enabled them, with a daily cap per user. This Parfumo route was read in the site's form but never exercised by this server. Supports dry_run. Requires a linked Parfumo account.

oneOf.description: Look for a sample or decant.

condition.description: Condition, as the site's form names it (default of the form: "any").

dry_run.description: When true, nothing is sent: the answer shows the request that would be made.

notes.description: Free note (250 characters at most), in the user's own words.

perfume.description: Perfume the entry is about: `id`, Parfumo URL or numeric `p_id`.

price.description: Price expectation (150 characters at most), in the user's own words.

shipping.description: Shipping costs and processing (150 characters at most), in the user's own words.

souk_id.description: Numeric id of an existing entry of the user to modify. Without it a new entry is created.

swap_for.description: What the user would swap for (250 characters at most), in the user's own words.

name: parfumo_souk_manage_offer

WriteCall.description:
A write request to Parfumo, as built before being sent (also shown by `dry_run`).
The session `csrf_key` is added at send time and never appears here.

form.description: Form fields (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`), without the CSRF token.

dry_run.description: True when nothing was sent to Parfumo.

executed.description: True when at least one write request was sent.

notes.description: Side effects and things to know.

planned_requests.description: The write requests sent, or that would be sent (CSRF and form tokens omitted).

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server is allowed to send publicly visible writes (operator setting).

result_url.description: Parfumo URL of the result, when Parfumo returned one.

target.description: What the write is aimed at: member, forum topic, perfume…
